responseMessageContents.text:
Done. The map now shows peaks progressively as you zoom:

- **World view**: only 7500m+ giants (Everest, K2, etc.) + all your summited peaks
- **Continental**: 6500m+
- **Regional**: 5000m+
- **Country**: 3500m+
- **Zoomed in**: all peaks

Your summited peaks always show regardless of zoom, and a hint in the legend tells users to zoom in for more.

responseMessageContents.title: Improved the map to show mountains more clearly based on your zoom level.
responseMessageContents.description: Updated the map so that famous high peaks like Everest are visible from a distance, while smaller mountains appear as you zoom in closer. Any mountains you have already climbed will now always stay visible on the map.
